title: Curtis LeMay gave D. Harold Byrd a Civil Air Patrol award

tellings.quote: Curtis Lame gave him an award for the Civil Airore when he was younger.

plain: Curtis LeMay, the hard-line Air Force general, is said to have given a Texas businessman named D. Harold Byrd an award for his work with the Civil Air Patrol, the Air Force's civilian volunteer wing, when Byrd was younger. Michels mentions this himself, without naming a source, in an episode on UFOs and the Kennedy assassination, where it serves to tie Byrd to the military figures around that story and to Lyndon Johnson.
